answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47909 Country: India Title: Delay in breaking the Ramadan Fast Question: One day during fast in Ramadan, I fell asleep before Maghrib and woke up almost half an hour after Maghrib to break my fast. Did this delay invalidate my fast and I have to make qaza only or qaza and kaffarah both. Answer ID: 47909 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1392/1064/B=11/1434) It is mustahab to do iftar as soon as the sun sets. The sawm was not invalid due to delay. وفى البدائع: ويسن تعجيل الافطار اذا غربت الشمس هكذا روى عن ابى حنيفة – (2/105) وفى نورالايضاح: ويستحب له ثلاثة (1) السحور (2) تاخيره (3) تعجيل الافطار فى غير يوم الغيم . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
